title: Sign conjunction indicator formula
statement:
For signs $a,b,c\in\{−1,1\}$, let $a\wedge b$ denote the sign that equals $-1$ exactly when both $a$ and $b$ equal $-1$. The indicator of $a\wedge b=c$ is
\[\mathbf{1}_{a\wedge b=c}=\frac{2+c+ac+bc-abc}{4},\]
where each sign on the right is viewed as a real number.
